One of my favorite #bookseries “Baker Street Boys by  Anthony Read”
This one is first in the serie, “The Case of the Disappearing Detective”
The stories set in 1897, there is a group of orphan kids in baker street living in a secret cellar. Even in this group has three girls in it and four boys, they call themselves “The Baker Street Boys”
the Baker Street Boys are helping Sherlock Holmes solve a case when Holmes himself disappears. Only the Boys realize that he hasn’t gone undercover but has actually been kidnapped by a Fenian gang from Boston who are planning to assassinate the Queen.
I simply love this really engaging and full of adventures.
